krotki: Connect letters, fill relaxing crosswords and travel across Poland's landscapes.
pelny:
Word Trail is a calm word game where a handful of letters builds a whole crossword.

HOW TO PLAY
Swipe across the letters in the wheel to make a word. Every word that fits drops into the crossword. Find them all and move on along the trail.

WHAT'S INSIDE
• Over 2000 levels, from three-letter warm-ups to seven-letter puzzles
• A journey across Poland: the Tatra Mountains, the Masurian Lakes, the Baltic Coast, Białowieża Forest, the Błędów Desert and more
• Hand-drawn landscapes at dawn, by day, at sunset and at night, sometimes with the northern lights
• Daily challenge: a new crossword every morning and a streak to keep
• Bonus word jar: find extra words that are not in the crossword and earn coins
• Hints when you get stuck and one-tap letter shuffle
• Gentle sounds and vibration that you can turn off

PLAY YOUR WAY
No account and no time limit. The game works offline. Good with a coffee, on the bus and before bed.

Words come from the ENABLE word list (public domain) and the FrequencyWords list (CC BY-SA 4.0). The game is free and shows ads. The game is also available in Polish.
